title: dependabot-generator configuration
description: Schema for the .depgen.toml configuration file used by dependabot-generator.

header.description: Custom comment text prepended to the generated dependabot.yml. Supports multi-line strings. When omitted, the built-in default URL reference is used.

ignore-dirs.description: Glob patterns matched against directory base names. Matching directories are skipped during the scan. Uses filepath.Match semantics. When specified, replaces (not appends to) the built-in defaults.

items.description: A glob pattern compatible with Go filepath.Match (e.g., node_modules, .*, vendor).

ecosystems.description: Per-ecosystem default fields injected into each generated update entry. Keys use dotted paths that expand into nested YAML (e.g., schedule.interval becomes schedule: { interval: ... }). The special _default key applies to all ecosystems unless overridden by a more specific section.

^(_default|bazel|bun|bundler|cargo|compo.description: A map of dotted-path keys to their values. Keys correspond to Dependabot v2 update entry fields using dot notation for nesting.

schedule.interval.description: How often to check for updates.

schedule.day.description: Day of the week to check for updates (only for weekly schedule).

insecure-external-code-execution.description: Whether to allow or deny execution of external code during dependency updates.

open-pull-requests-limit.description: Maximum number of open pull requests for version updates.

cooldown.default-days.description: Number of days to wait before re-attempting a failed update.

cooldown.semver-major-days.description: Number of days to wait before re-attempting a failed major version update.

cooldown.semver-minor-days.description: Number of days to wait before re-attempting a failed minor version update.

cooldown.semver-patch-days.description: Number of days to wait before re-attempting a failed patch version update.

^groups\\..+\\.patterns$.description: Glob patterns for grouping dependencies together in a single pull request.

^groups\\..+\\.update-types$.description: SemVer update types to include in this dependency group.

^groups\\..+\\.dependency-type$.description: The type of dependencies to include in this group.

examples.header: # Managed by dependabot-generator. Do not edit.
